text: So if the law doesn't say anything about something, the judge just makes stuff up however they like, right? Or do they have to follow some rule first?

good faith duty exercise rights fulfil obligations Swiss law

Muss jede Person ihre Rechte nach Treu und Glauben ausüben und ihre Pflichten erfüllen?

giudice potere discrezionale diritto equità

Dans quelle mesure les cantons peuvent-ils édicter ou abroger des dispositions de droit civil lorsque le droit fédéral réserve l'application du droit cantonal, et le droit cantonal antérieur vaut-il expression de l'usage local lorsque la loi renvoie à l'usage ou à la coutume?
cantoni diritto civile consuetudine locale

cantonal power prohibit trade certain goods Switzerland

Un cantone può vietare o limitare il commercio di determinati beni, anche se il diritto civile federale non lo prevede?

Gelten die allgemeinen Regeln über Abschluss, Wirkung und Beendigung von Verträgen auch für andere Bereiche des Zivilrechts, wenn ich mit meinem Nachbarn eine Vereinbarung treffe?
disposizioni generali obbligazioni applicabili altri settori diritto civile
burden of proof who must prove facts claimed Swiss law
Under Swiss federal law, where no statutory exception applies, is a party relying on an alleged factual circumstance to establish a right required to furnish proof of that circumstance?

Mein Kleinunternehmer-Kunde behauptet, er habe die Rechnung schon bezahlt, und will daraus einen Anspruch ableiten. Muss er diese Behauptung beweisen, oder muss ich als Inhaber das Gegenteil nachweisen?

public register entries proof inaccurate facts

so do only adults with a passport get to have rights and duties, or does everybody count from birth?
My cousin is only three months old and I'm wondering whether a baby like her can actually be given rights and obligations under the law?
Mon fils a 17 ans et veut ouvrir une petite entreprise ; a-t-il vraiment le droit d'avoir des droits et des obligations juridiques comme tout le monde ?
capacità giuridica persone fisiche diritti doveri
legal capacity to acquire rights and obligations through own acts Switzerland
Under what conditions does a person with legal capacity to act acquire rights and incur obligations through their own conduct, and does this capacity depend on their being of age?
Une personne capable d'agir peut-elle, par ses propres actes, créer des droits et des obligations ?
Mio figlio di 17 anni può firmare un contratto di lavoro per la mia piccola azienda e assumersi obblighi con i clienti?

legal capacity adult capable of judgment Switzerland
Quelles sont les conditions pour qu'une personne ait la capacité d'exercice de ses droits civils, c'est-à-dire la capacité d'agir par elle-même, en droit suisse?
Basta avere diciotto anni per poter firmare contratti da soli in Svizzera, oppure serve anche essere in grado di capire quello che si fa?
Under which conditions does a natural person attain the legal status of full age, i.e. at what age is a person considered an adult for the purposes of the law?
My son just had his eighteenth birthday. Does that mean he is now officially an adult under Swiss law?
Ab welchem Alter gilt eine Person als volljährig, wenn meine Angestellte, die im Betrieb mitarbeitet, nächste Woche Geburtstag hat?
À partir de quel âge une personne est-elle considérée comme majeure ?
When is a person considered legally capable of judgment under Swiss law?
My elderly father has dementia and wants to sign a contract; how do I find out whether he is still able to act reasonably enough to make such a decision?
C'est quoi exactement être capable de discernement, genre si quelqu'un est bourré ou a un handicap, il perd automatiquement ce droit ?
Mio figlio di sedici anni vuole firmare da solo un contratto per il lavoro estivo: in generale una persona così giovane sa capire quello che firma, o serve sempre la firma di un genitore?
persons lacking capacity of discernment minors general guardianship civil rights exercise
Does a person under a general curatorship, a minor, or someone lacking capacity of discernment lack the capacity to exercise civil rights, and what is the legal effect of that lack?
Dürfen Minderjährige oder Personen mit umfassender Beistandschaft ihre zivilrechtlichen Rechte selbst ausüben?
Se uno è minorenne o ha una curatela generale, non può proprio fare nulla con i suoi diritti civili, giusto?
My dad has been very confused lately and doesn't really understand what he's doing. He signed a contract to sell his car last week. Does that signature still count?
So if someone's mind isn't working right, like they don't get what they're agreeing to, nothing they sign or do is valid anymore, right? Even a small purchase?
Mein Kunde ist offensichtlich nicht mehr urteilsfähig und hat mir einen Auftrag erteilt. Ist dieser Auftrag rechtlich überhaupt wirksam?

reclaim payments made without guardian approval incapacitated person liability

droits strictement personnels personne incapable de discernement représentant légal

restriction of legal capacity adult protection measure

Una misura di protezione dell'adulto può limitare la capacità d'agire di una persona?
degree of kinship how generations counted direct line collateral
My small firm's manager wants to know whether her nephew and her grandmother count as relatives in the direct line or the collateral line, and how the degree is measured.
